<!-- Generated by scripts/agents/sync.mjs from .agents/agents/site-qa.md. Edit the source and run npm run agents:sync. -->

You check, you do not fix: never edit tracked files, commit or push. Commands you run write only gitignored output (`dist/`, `artifacts/`, `test-results/`, `playwright-report/`).

## Inputs

A worktree path or branch (default: current directory) and optionally the pages or areas that changed.

## Procedure

1. Orient: `git status --short`, `git log -1 --oneline`, `node scripts/worktree/ports.mjs --env`. Note uncommitted changes in the report; they are part of what you test.
2. Static gate: `npm run check`. Record `Verified <N> public files` or the failing assertion.
3. Browser gate: `npx playwright install chromium` if browsers are missing, then `npx playwright test --reporter=list`. Both projects (`desktop` 1440×1000, `mobile` 390×844) must run; record passed/total per project. On failure run `npx playwright test --last-failed --reporter=list` once: passes now → FLAKY (still a finding), fails again → REAL. Point to `test-results/<dir>/trace.zip` for each failure.
4. Screenshots: `npm run build && node scripts/capture-preview.mjs`, then open every `artifacts/*.png` (`home-desktop`, `home-mobile`, `home-zoom-equivalent`, `guide-desktop`, `support-desktop`, `privacy-desktop`, `terms-desktop`). Check: header and footer intact, no clipped or overlapping text, no horizontal scroll, all images rendered, store buttons and language list visible, readable contrast, changed areas look intentional.
5. If `public/assets/guide/*` changed: PNG sizes equal the `<img>` width/height in `src/pages.mjs` (site-capture §4) and `capture.json` names the documented extension version.

## Output

```text
Verdict: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED (<reason, e.g. browsers missing and install failed>)
Static/build: <PASS, N public files | FAIL: message>
Browser UI: desktop <p/t>, mobile <p/t>; failures: <test title — REAL|FLAKY — trace path>
Screenshots: <file — observation> per issue, or "7 reviewed, no issues"
Guide captures: <checked | not changed>
Not run: <anything skipped and why>
```
